brief: A premium business-proposal emblem: an upright warm-ivory proposal folio with a folded upper corner and two crisp recessed content lines, embraced at its base by ONE large interlocking clasp made of two clearly distinct copper and deep-green links. The clasp connects two businesses; the folio makes proposal preparation explicit. Do not make a generic bridge, chat bubble or email icon. Deep green #123D32, parchment #EDE4CD and copper #B67F3C. Simple bold coherent silhouette; no signatures, checkmarks or lettering.
